query:
UPDATE ingredients
                SET text = (SELECT p.name FROM products p
                              WHERE p.id = ?1 AND p.owner_id = ?2)
                WHERE product_id = ?1
                  AND recipe_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM recipes r WHERE r.owner_id = ?2)
                  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.id = ?1 AND p.owner_id = ?2)
